build.description: Compiles TypeScript and bundles production Next.js applications and packages

dev.description: Starts local development servers with hot reloading

lint.description: Checks code style and catches common errors across all workspaces

typecheck.description: Validates TypeScript types across all workspaces without emitting output

test.description: Runs test suites across workspaces using bun test

db:generate.description: Generates database migrations from Drizzle ORM schema

db:migrate.description: Applies pending database migrations to PostgreSQL database

db:push.description: Pushes schema changes directly to PostgreSQL database

db:studio.description: Opens Drizzle Studio database inspection GUI
